main_measure.name: mean short-direction 21-bar excess return of the deepest fifth of negative-forecast grid cases

statistic.name: t of the mean, cases summed per day

main_measure.threshold: mean above 0 with day-clustered t >= 2 confirms (with check); t <= -2 rejects

supporting_check.name: deepest fifth minus rest, short-direction excess return, Welch t >= 1

decided_by: The minimum of 30 distinct days among the deepest-fifth cases is not reached (22).
reading: The deepest fifth is the ceil(n/5) negative-forecast grid cases with the most negative forecast (ties broken by day then coin), the normal drift is each coin's mean non-overlapping 21-bar return over all its windows, the supporting Welch t is on individual cases, and fewer than 30 days gives 'not observable'.
